evidence.source: Ground- and excited-state geometry optimizations and NTO analysis are used to assign emissive states.
Complex 2 calculated S1 and T1 emission wavelengths are 689 and 605 nm.
PBE0/def2-TZVP, no dispersion, DFT/TDDFT excited-state optimizations, TDA, 10 singlets, IRoot=1, ORCA 5.0.
CCDC 2498911 is the supplementary crystallographic record for complex 2.
